report.answer_text:
Gold rose about 65% in U.S. dollar terms in 2025, its biggest annual gain since 1979. Spot gold gained 64.6%, while the London Bullion Market Association’s afternoon benchmark rose 67.4%, ending the year at $4,368 per troy ounce. (sifma.org)
Intraday spot record: Gold reached about $4,550 per troy ounce on December 26, 2025. (sifma.org)
London benchmark records: The afternoon benchmark set 53 new all-time highs in 2025, peaking at $4,449 on December 23, 2025. It also posted record averages of $3,431 for the full year and $4,135 for the fourth quarter. (gold.org)
